name: Runner Extras - Report StubMeta Unbounded Loop
brief: Proves the runner refuses to iterate a report's data items when no source describes that report, instead of synthesizing a data item that claims 'no bound' and looping to the Integer virtual table's edge (issue #3375).
description: Regression test for NavReportSync.BuildSyntheticFlatMetaDataItem. The dependency 'RSM Precompiled StubMeta Dep' (declared below, loaded from the committed .deps-bin/*.dll) ships reports 65821 and 65822 as pure compiled code, and its committed .alpackages/*.app carries NO SymbolReference.json — so neither of the runner's two metadata sources holds them: the emit registry never saw them (never source-compiled) and no symbol file declares them. Report 65821's data items therefore reached BC's DataItemIterator with a MetaDataItem synthesized from the data item's NAME alone, whose MaxIteration is 0 and whose DataItemTableView is absent. BC reads both as 'no bound', so a `MaxIteration = 1` data item over the Integer virtual table ran 101,001 times and a `where(Number = filter(1 .. 3))` sibling ran 101,001 times too. Measured on this fixture with the window shrunk to 1,051 rows: 1051 and 1051, against the declared 1 and 3. The runner now refuses that loop by name instead. Report 65822 declares no data items and is the proportionality control; report 65842 in this bundle declares the same two shapes and IS source-compiled here, so its emit-captured metadata bounds it at 1 and 3 and proves the refusal is scoped to reports nothing describes.
